name: zwA3_practical_active

tests.name: the engine's own practical report is readable, so active count is not inferred

detail.note: reads H.describe_practical_lights, added at 71114aab, because UE 5.8 Python has no world-subsystem getter at all -- enumerated, after BlueprintType was diagnosed as the cause and was not. Red here means the build predates that accessor, and the run voids rather than falling back to counting actors and inferring a radius again

tests.name: the pawn is at the densest spot, which is what selects the candidate set

detail.note: Assign() takes its Eye from the PAWN. Measured anywhere else this is a different question

tests.name: every rung produced an authoritative active count
the pawn is at the measurement spot at EVERY rung, not just when it was placed

detail.note: placed once before the loop and never checked again. Active read 31 at count 48 and at count 192 with 184 candidates in radius, where Lit = Min(Near, Pool) wants 48 and 184 -- and the only input to Assign other than the two knobs is the Eye, which is this

tests.name: the active count is unchanged across an independent wait at every rung

detail.note: five equal reads is a plateau test and a plateau passes it: the previous run held 127 three times and then reported 192. Only a wait that does nothing else separates a pause from an arrival, and a rung that has not arrived cannot be compared with a budget

tests.name: counting the actors agrees with the engine's own active count

detail.note: INFORMATIONAL about the OLD instrument. Red means actor counting was never a reliable stand-in for ActiveCount, which would explain the 31s that started the radius theory. The numbers reported by this job are the engine's either way

tests.name: the pool clips at the shipped budget -- the cap, not the radius, is what limits it

detail.note: clips means active == pool AND more manifest lights lie inside the radius the engine reports. Active BELOW pool means the radius ran out of candidates first and the budget is not the constraint. This gate is the claim itself: green proves clipping at 48, red disproves it, and either way it is measured rather than argued
